title: How a 22 year old built a million dollar app with AI

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: What if a 22-year-old built a million-dollar app using just AI — and it changed how we work, learn, and connect?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Today, tools like LangChain and AutoGPT let developers automate app logic, while generative AI creates UIs and content in minutes.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: But if AI-generated apps become common, we risk undervaluing human creativity and opening the door to deepfakes and misinformation.

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Many builders now use AI responsibly — with transparency layers, watermarking, and ethical guidelines to keep users informed and protected.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: Imagine a future where AI apps are co-created with humans, enhancing skills rather than replacing them — a partnership for progress.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: The future isn’t just about what AI can do — it’s about how we shape its role in society with vision and responsibility.

video_cue: A young developer typing on a laptop as AI-generated code appears on the screen alongside a growing revenue graph.
